verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own docs list a Create-Dashboard capability that assembles reports and text cards into a dashboard. Marketing copy says analyses are delivered as a dashboard the team can keep working from. Dedicated dashboard documentation is thin, though, and the composition evidence comes mainly from the MCP tool listing rather than the core UI workflow. Missing for 10: first-party docs on saving insights and adding them to dashboards in the UI, documented sharing/permission controls for teammates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can compose saved insights into shareable dashboards for my team
